name: Myosotis: My Life Is Not Yours to Take
source:
You've died at the hands of your (now ex) boyfriend, Ethan. Filled with a mix of sorrow, confusion, and rage, you decide to spend your afterlife haunting him in the hope of getting an answer from your murderer. However, you're only given more questions as you realize you're not the only ghost following him around...

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/myosotis]itch.io[/url]]
